# eclipse

[All servers](../mcp-tools.md)

Version: 1.0.0. Tools: 13.

## applyQuickFix

Apply a specific Quick Fix to resolve a problem. Use the fix index from the 'getQuickFixes' output to identify which fix to apply. This will automatically modify the code to resolve the issue.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project containing the file. Optional if file path is unique across projects or starts with /projectName/ |
| filePath | string | String | Yes | The path to the file relative to the project root (e.g., 'src/com/example/Main.java') or absolute path starting with /projectName/ |
| lineNumber | string | int | Yes | The line number where the problem is located (1-based index) |
| fixIndex | string | int | Yes | The index of the Quick Fix to apply (1-based, from getQuickFixes output) |

## findReferences

Find all references (usages) of a Java element across the workspace. This is essential for understanding the impact of changes before refactoring or modifying code. Returns locations with line numbers and code context.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| elementType | string | String | Yes | The type of element to search for: 'type' (class/interface), 'method', 'field', 'package', 'constructor' |
| elementName | string | String | Yes | The name of the element. For types: fully qualified name (e.g., 'com.example.User'). For methods/fields: simple name (e.g., 'getName') or qualified name (e.g., 'com.example.User.getName') |
| projectName | string | String | No | Optional project name to limit the search scope. If not specified, searches the entire workspace. |
| scope | string | String | No | Search scope: 'workspace' (default) searches all projects, 'project' searches only the specified project |
| includeSubtypes | string | Boolean | No | For type searches, include references to subtypes. Defaults to false. |

## getQuickFixes

Get available Quick Fixes (marker resolutions) for problems in a file. This lists all the automatic fixes Eclipse can apply to resolve compilation errors, warnings, and other issues. Use this after identifying problems with the 'problems' tool.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project containing the file. Optional if file path is unique across projects or starts with /projectName/ |
| filePath | string | String | Yes | The path to the file relative to the project root (e.g., 'src/com/example/Main.java') or absolute path starting with /projectName/ |
| lineNumber | string | String | No | Optional line number to filter problems at a specific line (1-based index) |
| problemId | string | String | No | Optional problem ID to filter a specific problem |

## refreshAndSave

Refresh files from disk and save them in Eclipse, triggering configured save actions (format on save, organize imports, etc.). Use this after modifying files externally to apply Eclipse formatting preferences automatically.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| paths | string | String | Yes | Comma-separated list of file paths relative to project root |

## run

Run an Eclipse launch configuration. Async by default with file logging.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| configuration | string | String | No | Configuration name, if empty will return all configuration names |
| waitForCompletion | boolean | Boolean | No | If true, waits for the process to terminate (max 120s). Default: false |
